reason: Read with L 305 and the 1474 print at hand, the faded verso became legible as '[cu]stodiat me in uitam eternam', Placeat and Meritis et precibus, and much of the small hand that the image-only reading left unread ('Eructauit', 'exh[abundancia]', 'elizabet inspirasti', the Song of Songs lesson) could be read.
sources: Fribourg, BCU, Ms. L 305, Missale Cisterciense, about 1300 (Hauterive), ff. 144r-144v, e-codices page images https://www.e-codices.unifr.ch/en/bcuf/L0305/144r

text:
F-v82x (Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 69). Source-assisted reading, 31 October 2026, made with Fribourg BCU L 305 (ff. 144r-144v) and the Missale Romanum, Milan 1474 (ed. Lippe, vol. 1, pp. 210-211; vol. 2, p. 208) at hand. A research reader reread on the native images the whole recto (canvas 1, 17 lines), verso lines 1 and 3-9 in the main hand, and the five lines on the folded bottom flap. An independent checker read lines 1-8 of the small hand on the verso on the image before opening Lippe. All other small-hand words rest on scattered readings only. Not a verified transcription.
Conventions: expansions in ( ), lost or supplied text in [ ], ? doubtful, / line break, [red] rubric, [+] red cross. Boxes are left,top,right,bottom in native pixels (7360 x 4912). The catalogue labels are reversed: canvas 1 (Stams_STA_Frg_069_01v) is the recto, canvas 0 (Stams_STA_Frg_069_01r) the verso.

== Recto, canvas 1 (Stams_STA_Frg_069_01v), boxes 2400,1700,4800,2750 and 2400,2650,4800,4050
[preter]itib(us) et futuris. et int[ercede]nte beata et glo[riosa] / [sem]p(er) uirgine dei genitrice [..] et beatis ap(osto)[l]/[is tu]is. Petro et Paulo. atq(ue) Andrea cum o(mn)ib(us) / s(an)c(t)is da p(ro)picius pacem in dieb(us) n(ost)ris ut ope mi[seri]/cordie tue adiuti et a peccato sim(us) semp(er) liberi et / ab omni p(er)turbatione securi. P(er) eunde(m) d(omi)n(u)m n(ost)r(u)m / ihm xpm filiu(m) tuu(m) qui tecu(m) uiuit et regnat in uni/tate sp(iritu)s s(an)c(t)i d(eu)s. Per omnia secula sec(u)lor(um). amen. / Pax [+] d(omi)ni. sit semp(er) uobiscum [+]. Et cu(m) spiritu / tuo. Agnus dei. [rest of line ghost-faint, unread] / Hec sacro s(an)c(t)a co(m)mixtio corporis et sanguinis d(omi)ni / n(ost)ri ihu xpi. fiat m(ichi) et omnib(us) su(m)entib(us) salus mentis / et corporis et ad uita(m) et(er)nam p(ro)merenda(m) et capessenda(m) / p(re)paratio salutaris amen. / D(omi)ne ihu xpe fili dei uiui. qui [ex uolun]tate p(at)ris / cooperante sp(irit)u s(an)c(t)o p(er) morte(m) tua(m) mu(n)du(m) uiui[fi]casti / libera me q(ue)so p(er) hoc sacro s(an)c(tu)m corp(us) et sanguine(m) tuu(m) / [line 18 cut: ascenders only]

== Verso, canvas 0 (Stams_STA_Frg_069_01r), main hand, box 2850,1650,5250,2600
[cu]stodiat m[e in] uitam eternam. amen. / [ghost line, unread] / Placeat t[ibi s(an)c(t)a tri]nitas obsequium seru[i/tutis] mee et [presta ut hoc tuu]m sacrificium. / quod [oc]ulis [tue maie]statis indignus obtuli / sit tibi acce[pta]bile michiq(ue) et omnib(us) p(ro) quib(us) / illud obtuli te miser[an]te sit propiciabile. Q(ui) uiuis / Meritis et [pre]cib(us) istorum et omnium s(an)c(t)or(um) / suorum mi[serea]tur nostri om(ni)p(oten)s d(omi)n(u)s. amen.
The gap after "trinitas" seems short for "unus deus"; the line is faded.

== Verso, canvas 0, small hand, lines 1-8, boxes 2850,2950,4100,3600 and 4000,2950,5300,3600 (blue-channel crops for the line openings, 2950,2960,4100,3130)
1 [red G] Gaudeamus o[mnes ...] ... [ce]lebrantes sub honore [..]e ma[rie] uirgi[nis] de cu[ius ..] (line end under the fold)
2 an[geli? ...] ... [coll]audant filium dei. [red] V. Eructauit cor meum uerbum bonum dico [ego ...]
3 [..] [red] Collecta [red O] ... [..]s d(eu)s qui exh[abundancia ...] ... [..]
4 [..] elizabet inspirasti? p(re)sta q(uesumu)s ut p(er) eius ... [..]ple[amur ...]
5 [...] ... [red] lectio libri sapiencie
6 [...tra]nsiliens colles. [red S] Similis e(st) dilect(us) m(eus) capree ...
7 [...] en ipse stat post pariete(m) n(ost)r(u)m respiciens ...
8 [...can]cellos. [En] dilect(us) m(eus) loq[uitur ...]
The feast word after "de cuius" is not legible. "elizabet inspirasti" is probable, not certain.

== Verso, canvas 0, folded bottom flap, box 2900,3550,5250,3980
... ficus protulit [grossos] suos ... [o]dorem dederu(n)t. Surge p(ro)pera amica mea speciosa mea et ueni colu[mba] / mea in foraminib(us) [petre in ca]uerna macerie. ostende m(ihi) faciem tua(m). Sonet uox tua in / auribus meis. [uox enim tua] dulcis. et facies tua decora. [red] R. Benedicta et uenerabilis es / [..] inuenta es m(ate)r saluatoris. [red] V. Virgo dei genitri[x] / [letter tops only]
